# Fair fees, No surprises
Low, crystal-clear fees and discounts when you send more.

## Send more, pay less
That’s why you get a discount when you send over 25,000 USD (or equivalent).

We apply your discount automatically as soon as you hit 25,000 USD or equivalent. Whether you send in one or multiple transfers.

## Nothing but the mid-market rate
We only use the live mid-market rate, and a small, upfront fee to cover our costs.

# Fees for sending money
To see exactly how much your transfer could cost, visit our [pricing page](https://wise.com/pricing/).

How much a transfer costs depends on three things — the amount you’re sending, how you pay, and the exchange rate.

#### **The amount you’re sending**
The percentage varies from currency to currency, and you can check it on our pricing page.

#### **How you pay**
There are different ways to pay depending on the country you’re sending from. Sending same-currency transfers between Wise accounts is free.
